title: OpenJoystickDriver endpoint access grants
description: The file AccessGrants.json in the OpenJoystickDriver Application Support folder. Only the service writes it, when 'ojd access enable', 'disable', 'grant', 'revoke', 'web enable', or 'web disable' runs.

web.description: The WebSocket and overlay pages on 127.0.0.1.

enabled.description: Whether the service listens on the port.

port.description: Absent until the first enable, which saves the port the system picked unless one was given.

scope.description: 'read' receives controller events; 'control' drives a virtual gamepad.

token.description: A named token that lets a client use the endpoint without a signature check. The token itself is not stored.

tokenSHA256.description: The SHA-256 of the token, in lowercase hex.

origins.description: The web origins whose pages may use the token on the WebSocket; empty for a token that works only on the Unix socket.

grant.description: A client the user allowed, matched by its code signature.

kind.description: 'team' matches the identifier signed by an Apple-issued certificate of the team; 'apple' matches the identifier signed by Apple.

teamIdentifier.description: The signing team; present for 'team' grants.

grantedAt.description: When the latest 'ojd access grant' for this client ran.

path.description: Where the client was when it was granted; for display only.
